_about: SI prefixes, the seven SI defining constants and the Greek alphabet. Each section records what each publisher prints; an entry counts as confirmed when two independent publishers print the same. The 'used' text beside a Greek letter is BenchMate's own: what the letter stands for in BenchMate's formula library.

BIPM_PREFIX.title: SI prefixes
BIPM_PREFIX.note: 24 prefixes from quetta (10^30) to quecto (10^-30); cites CGPM Resolution 3 (2022), On the extension of the range of SI prefixes.

NIST_PREFIX.title: Metric (SI) prefixes
NIST_PREFIX.note: Same 24 prefixes; spells 10^1 as deka (US spelling) where BIPM prints deca.

BIPM_CONST.title: The International System of Units (SI): defining constants

NIST_SP330.title: Special Publication 330, section 2, Table 1 (the defining constants of the SI)

WARWICK.title: Mathematics undergraduate handbook: the Greek alphabet
WARWICK.note: 24 letters with variant lower-case forms of epsilon, theta, pi, rho and phi.

ETB.title: Greek alphabet
ETB.note: 24 letters; also the final sigma used at the end of a word.

BIPM_CONST: Luminous efficacy of a defined visible radiation
NIST_SP330: Luminous efficacy of a defined visible radiation

greek_used.alpha: α: pressure angle of a gear, an included angle, thermal expansion coefficient
greek_used.delta: δ: deflection, interference of a fit; Δ: a difference
greek_used.theta: θ: an angle (point angle, chamfer angle)
greek_used.kappa: κ: entering angle of a cutting edge
greek_used.mu: μ: friction coefficient; µ as the prefix micro
greek_used.sigma: σ: standard deviation; Σ: a sum
greek_used.phi: φ: engagement angle of a milling cutter
greek_used.psi: ψ: half angle of a gear tooth at a radius
